evals.prompt: 我在寫一個 Go 專案(module path: github.com/acme/orders),想要用 clean architecture 幫我刻一個 Order 實體。欄位有 id (int64)、customerId (int64)、totalAmount (float64)、status (PENDING/PAID/CANCELLED)。業務規則:Cancel() 只有 PENDING 狀態可以取消,取消後要發送一個 OrderCancelledEvent。需要串接一個外部 PaymentClient 去查金流狀態(用 client adapter 包起來就好,SDK 細節你自己編)。API 要有 POST /api/orders 建立訂單、PUT /api/orders/{id}/cancel 取消訂單、GET /api/orders/{id} 查詢。這是這個專案第一次刻這種分層,麻煩先幫我確認一下 TDD 流程,先寫測試再寫實作。
evals.expected_output: Full compilable Go clean-architecture layer set for Order (domain/usecase/adapter-outbound/adapter-inbound), plus the one-time shared kernel (domainerr, usecaseerr, Gin error middleware), plus domain and usecase tests written before implementation.

evals.prompt: 同一個專案(github.com/acme/orders)裡,我還想加一個 Coupon 實體,欄位是 id (int64)、code (string)、discountPercent (int)。目前只需要一個 GET /api/coupons/{id} 查詢功能就好,先不用寫測試。這個專案已經有共用的錯誤處理基礎設施了(internal/domain/domainerr/domainerr.go、internal/usecase/usecaseerr/not_found.go、internal/adapter/inbound/http/middleware/error_handler.go 這三個檔案在刻 Order 實體時已經產生過),不要重複產生,直接沿用。
evals.expected_output: Go clean-architecture layer set for a read-only Coupon entity (domain/usecase/adapter-outbound/adapter-inbound), reusing the existing shared kernel without regenerating it, no test files since none were requested.
